name: Analyse Comparative Annuelle
description: Comparaison des indicateurs N vs N-1

query.sql: WITH current_year AS (SELECT 'CA Total' as indicateur, SUM(montant_ttc) as annee_courante FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) UNION SELECT 'Nombre factures', COUNT(*) FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) UNION SELECT 'Panier moyen', AVG(montant_ttc) FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)), previous_year AS (SELECT 'CA Total' as indicateur, SUM(montant_ttc) as annee_precedente FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 UNION SELECT 'Nombre factures', COUNT(*) FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 UNION SELECT 'Panier moyen', AVG(montant_ttc) FROM factures WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_facture) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) SELECT c.indicateur, ROUND(p.annee_precedente::numeric, 2) as annee_n_1, ROUND(c.annee_courante::numeric, 2) as annee_n, ROUND(((c.annee_courante - p.annee_precedente) / p.annee_precedente * 100)::numeric, 2) as evolution_pct FROM current_year c JOIN previous_year p ON c.indicateur = p.indicateur ORDER BY c.indicateur
